title: Simple Business Plan Template
description: Free one-page business plan template for startups, freelancers, and small businesses.
intro: This simple business plan template helps entrepreneurs organize their goals, services, target market, and financial strategy in a clear and professional format. It is designed for startups, freelancers, and small businesses that need a lightweight planning document.
whenToUse: Use this template when launching a business, seeking funding, planning growth, or organizing business strategy.
template:
Business Name: [Business Name]

Business Overview:
[Describe your business]

Products or Services:
[List products/services]

Target Market:
[Describe your ideal customers]

Marketing Strategy:
[Explain how you will attract customers]

Financial Goals:
[Revenue goals and projections]

Operations Plan:
[Daily operations and logistics]
example:
Business Name: Bright Pixel Studio

Business Overview:
A freelance design agency focused on branding and web design.

Logo design, website design, social media branding.

Target Market:
Small businesses and startups.

SEO, referrals, and LinkedIn outreach.
tips: Keep your business plan concise and easy to understand.
Focus on clear goals and realistic projections.
Update your business plan regularly as the business evolves.
Tailor the plan to your audience if seeking funding.

faqs.question: What is a simple business plan?
faqs.answer: A simple business plan outlines a company’s goals, strategy, target market, and financial overview in a concise format.

faqs.question: Can startups use this template?
faqs.answer: Yes, this template works well for startups and early-stage businesses.

faqs.question: Do investors require business plans?
faqs.answer: Many investors and lenders require business plans before providing funding.

faqs.question: How much should I budget for a restaurant startup?
faqs.answer: Typical restaurant startups cost $250,000-$450,000, depending on location, size, and concept.

faqs.question: What's a realistic timeline to break-even?
faqs.answer: Most restaurants take 2-3 years to break-even, so plan cash flow carefully.

faqs.question: Should I include staffing costs in the plan?
faqs.answer: Yes, labor is typically 28-35% of restaurant revenue, so detailed staffing plans are essential.

faqs.question: What shipping options should I offer?

title: Startup Business Plan Template
description: Free startup business plan template for tech startups, early-stage companies, and venture-backed businesses.
intro: This startup business plan template is designed for early-stage companies seeking investor funding or planning their growth trajectory. It includes sections for technology differentiation, market opportunity, funding requirements, and unit economics.
whenToUse: Use this template when pitching to investors, applying for startup loans, planning your product roadmap, or seeking venture capital funding.
template:
Startup Business Plan

Company Name: [Name]
Mission: [Statement]

Problem & Solution:
Problem: [Market pain point]
Solution: [Your offering]
Why Now: [Market timing]

Market Opportunity:
Total Addressable Market (TAM): $[Amount]
Serviceable Market: $[Amount]
Target Segment: [Description]

Product & Technology:
Key Features: [List]
Tech Stack: [Platforms/Languages]
IP/Moat: [Competitive advantage]

Business Model:
Revenue Model: [Pricing strategy]
Unit Economics: [Breakdown]
Gross Margin: [%]

Round Target: $[Amount]
Use of Funds: [Breakdown by category]
Runway: [Months]

Team:
- Founder: [Role/Experience]

example:
Startup Business Plan

Company Name: MoodFlow
Mission: Make workplace mental health accessible through AI-powered support

Problem & Solution:
Problem: 60% of employees lack access to mental health support
Solution: AI chatbot + licensed therapist network for employees
Why Now: Post-pandemic mental health crisis, enterprise software adoption

Market Opportunity:
TAM: $5B (US employee wellness)
Serviceable Market: $800M (mid-market focus)
Target Segment: Tech companies, 500-5,000 employees

Product & Technology:
Key Features: AI triage, peer support, therapist matching
Tech Stack: Python, React, AWS
IP/Moat: Proprietary mental health assessment algorithm

Business Model:
Revenue Model: $10/employee/month SaaS
Unit Economics: $0.30 CAC, $8 LTV (annual)

Use realistic, data-driven market size estimates.
Include detailed financial projections for 3-5 years.
Highlight what makes your team uniquely qualified.
Be transparent about risks and competitive landscape.

faqs.question: How much should I ask for in my first funding round?
faqs.answer: Typically 18-24 months of runway; calculate burn rate and request accordingly.

faqs.question: What metrics do investors care about most?
faqs.answer: Growth rate, unit economics, retention rate, and market opportunity are key metrics.

faqs.question: Should I bootstrap or seek venture funding?
faqs.answer: Depends on market size and growth speed needed; bootstrap for smaller markets, VC for large markets requiring speed.

Track monthly and annual recurring revenue separately.
Set retention targets (90%+ monthly retention is healthy).
Build in expansion revenue from upsells and add-ons.

faqs.question: What's a healthy CAC to LTV ratio for SaaS?
faqs.answer: A 3:1 LTV:CAC ratio is the minimum; 5:1 or higher is ideal.

faqs.question: What churn rate is acceptable for SaaS?
faqs.answer: Early-stage SaaS typically targets 5-7% monthly churn; mature SaaS targets 1-3%.

faqs.question: Should I start with free trial or freemium?
faqs.answer: Free trials work for high-touch sales; freemium works for self-serve PLG products. Choose based on sales model.
